products.title: Frontier Tyre Plug Kit
products.description: New tubeless plug kit stocked by Frontier Moto for roadside punctures. Reamer, plugs, insertion tool and glue in a roll that fits under most seats. Practise once on a dead tyre at home.

specs.v: Nail and screw holes in tread

products.title: Compact Tyre Inflator
products.blurb: 12V inflator with duty cycle to finish the job
products.description: New compact inflator sold by Frontier Moto. Sized for a pannier, wired for direct battery connection, with a duty cycle that finishes a rear tyre without a rest stop.

products.title: Two Piece Rain Suit
products.description: New two piece rain suit chosen for the long rains. Taped seams, ankle gussets, cut to go over armour rather than under it. Packs smaller than a one piece.

products.title: Dry Bag 40 Litre
products.description: New 40 litre dry bag with roll closure and compression straps. Cheaper and lighter than hard cases, and it does not widen the bike in traffic. No security, which is the honest limit.

products.title: Dual Purpose Rear Tyre
products.description: New road biased dual purpose tyre for riders who meet murram occasionally rather than daily. Date codes checked on arrival. State your size when ordering.

products.title: Vented Full Face Helmet
products.description: New vented full face helmet. Ventilation matters more than weight at equatorial midday. Never buy a helmet used: the damage that matters sits inside the shell. State your size when ordering.

products.title: Rated Reflective Vest
products.blurb: Class rated, one you will wear
products.description: New class rated reflective vest. Any rated vest beats none, and the one you actually wear beats the better one left at home. Fits over a jacket.

products.title: Frontier Field Notebook
products.description: New workshop notebook finished by Frontier Moto. Wax cover that survives a tank bag, with service log and fuel pages inside. Built for the rider a long way from a workshop.
